title: The Harm Caused by the Elderly
text: After leaving the dungeon, we emerged into the castle courtyard from the far end of the garden.
“Now that we’re here, it’s clear!”
“What a trickster!”
That’s when the castle guards started making a commotion.
“You! Eclair! You betrayed the country alongside that fake spearman!”
It’s a hassle to go easy on them. I’ll just use my Skills to avoid destroying the castle.
“Meteor Thrust!”
“Gwa—”
Struck by my Meteor Thrust, the soldier who had rushed toward us was reduced to a pile of charcoal. Father’s enemy is my enemy. I show no mercy to my foes!
“Wh—”
Éclair was speechless, staring at me.
“What’s the matter? If I don’t brush off the sparks that fly my way, I won’t be able to protect those I’m meant to protect, you know?”
“…I understand. But please, try not to kill them if you can.”
“I suppose I have no choice. Brionac!”
I sweep aside the soldiers who’ve rushed in with a restrained Brionac.
“Come on, we must hurry to Father’s side!”

I run into the castle. Where is my father?! Without stopping, I headed straight for the room where he was supposed to be staying. Along the way, I encountered soldiers time and again and defeated them one by one.
“Motoyasu! Stop it!”
“Motoyasu-san! What are you doing, causing such a commotion!?”
“Ah, isn’t that Ren and Itsuki? Where is my father?”

Ren and Itsuki had come running after hearing the commotion. I spoke to them in a friendly tone, but they looked at me as if I were a madman. Then, when I casually swept aside and defeated a soldier who was attacking me with my spear, Ren and Itsuki gulped in astonishment.
“You’re so strong… What level are you, exactly?”
“How did you get that strong…? You’re supposed to be Level 1, right?”
“Didn’t I tell you I came from the future? My level hasn’t gone down.”
“What!? T-then…”
“Are those the Sword Hero and the Bow Hero? Then where is the Shield Hero?”
Éclair asked, looking at Ren and the others standing opposite me. Indeed, my Father wasn’t there. Where on earth could he have gone?
“Motoyasu, why are you causing a scene?”
“Because you set a trap to separate me from my Father—this is my revenge.”
“A trap!?”
“Yes. I was dropped into the underground by that trap, but I managed to escape.”
“The underground… really…?”
Just as we were talking about this, that Trash showed up.
“What’s all this commotion!?”
“Your Majesty!”
“Motoyasu says he was trapped—is that true?”
“Depending on the circumstances, I’ll kill you, Trash.”
“Trash!?”
Ren is speechless at my words.
“Aren’t you getting a little too cocky just because you’re strong?”
“I don’t know about that. But if you don’t answer soon, my patience is about to run out.”

I prepare to unleash a high-powered Brionac, crackling with energy. Even though he was originally one of the Seven Star Heroes, taking a hit from this enhanced Motoyasu won’t end well for him. Since he’s messed up both last time and this time, I figure it’s fine to blow a hole or two in him.
“I-it seems the Spear Hero is under a misunderstanding.”
The Trash muttered, sounding flustered.
“A misunderstanding? Do you really think an excuse like that will fly?”

“J-just a moment ago, an envoy from Siltvelt arrived unexpectedly to take the Shield Hero away. And it seems that some Demi-Humans disguised as castle soldiers were planning to use our castle’s traps to eliminate the Spear Hero for political reasons.”
A Demi-Human soldier was brought in at that moment. No… he’s already dead.
“It seems this man tried to frame the Spear Hero and kill the Sword Hero and Bow Heroes… but he committed suicide when we tried to capture him.”
“No way…”
“I was looking for you, Motoyasu, to see Naofumi off, but you were gone, so I’ve been searching for you.”

…It’s an incredibly suspicious turn of events, but I can’t say it doesn’t seem to add up. Still, there are endless things that seem fishy. Above all, the people I trust are Filo-tan and my Father. There’s no way I could ever believe the words of someone trying to frame my Father.
“Are you asking me to believe that?”

I’ll prepare to fire the Brionac at maximum power. Putting the information together, it means my Father has already departed for Siltvelt by carriage. And just as we were passing each other, I was nearly killed by a messenger from Siltvelt—a soldier in disguise—who set a trap for me. They say the soldiers panicked when I appeared out of nowhere and attacked me…
“Your Majesty, I must say, that’s not very convincing!”
Éclair steps forward and declares.
“Huh!? Why is the daughter of the prisoner, Seaetto, here? Did she escape!?”

“Lord Kitamura granted my request to verify the truth of the matter! O King, it’s not too late even now. I implore you to stop setting a trap for the Shield Hero. The Queen would never tolerate such barbaric acts!”
“M-my wife’s thoughts are my own! Return to your cell at once, you felon! It’s already a mercy that I’m even speaking with you—what is this attitude?!”

Éclair’s shoulders slumped in disappointment, but then she glared fiercely at that Trash. That scum—he’s the kind of person you should just ignore. After all, he’s nothing but a useless old fogey who isn’t worth trusting in the first place.
“I understand the King’s decision. From this moment on, I will accompany Lord Kitamura, the Spear Hero, and pursue the Shield Hero.”
“Wait! Are you defying me?!”
“As for whether I’ll accept punishment… I’ll reserve judgment until I hear it from the Queen’s own lips. Until then, I’ll act according to my own convictions!”
With a sharp clang, it seems Éclair is infusing her sword with Magical Power.
“Well then, our conversation is over. Go ahead and say your final words before you vanish from this world.”
“W-what did you say!? Are you saying the Spear Hero is going to kill me?!”
She aimed her Brionac at that piece of Trash. I said I’d listen to what you have to say, but I never said I wouldn’t kill you. It’s a conversational technique I learned from my Father.

“Lord Kitamura, I beg you to hold off on that. You are recognized as an ally of the Shield Hero. Even if you were to defeat that king, in the current situation, it would jeopardize the Shield Hero’s position as well.”
“It won’t make a difference even if I eliminate him here. The seeds of evil must be nipped in the bud.”
He’s just an old fogey, after all. Eliminating him here shouldn’t pose a problem for the bigger picture.
Rin and Itsuki sense my killing intent and step in to protect him. At this rate, I might accidentally kill them both. Then I’d end up in a loop.

This is getting tedious. Should I just start over from the beginning to make things easier? If there’s a next loop, perhaps I should exercise some restraint—based on what I’ve learned this time—to avoid causing any trouble.
“Ren-kun, Itsuki-kun. Remember this well. If you trust this country, you’ll only end up getting hurt. Be especially careful of the Crimson Swine.”

That said, I won’t give up on saving my Father until the very end. I should still be able to recover from this mistake. I must chase after my Father as soon as possible. I hold off on activating Brionac and lower my spear.
“Alright, let’s go, Éclair!”
“No! My name is Éclair!”
“Wait!”
“Don’t chase him! If you go after him now, everyone here will be killed!”
That Trash called back the soldiers and Ren and the others who were about to give chase. And so, I left the castle in pursuit of my Father.

The town below the castle is bustling with activity at night. Where could my father be headed…? This is a real headache. The back alleys of the town, or perhaps the plains beyond them… I have no idea how far the carriage carrying my father has gone.

This is just my guess, but the so-called envoy from Siltvelt is undoubtedly a Melromarc soldier. They deceived my father, who knew nothing, and took him away somewhere. The city gates should be closed, but I can’t completely rule out the possibility that they were opened as an exception.
“Lord Kitamura! I’ve got some crucial information!”
“What is it?”
“Apparently, the gate opened a little while ago and a carriage drove out.”
“I see. There’s a high chance my Father is in that carriage.”
I rush toward the gate. I don’t know what kind of carriage it is, but catching up on foot would be nearly impossible… What should I do?
“Why have you been calling the Shield Hero ‘Father’ for the past few moments, Mr. Kitamura?”
“Because he’s Filo-tan’s Father, you see.”
“Is she the one you’re in love with, Mr. Kitamura?”
“That’s right. Filo-tan is an angel sent from heaven! She’s the supreme being who heals my heart.”
“U-um… So the Shield Hero must be quite elderly, then.”
“He’s twenty years old.”
“Who on earth is Lord Kitamura’s beloved?!”
Éclair is being quite a handful. But… if we’ve passed through the castle town…
“Portal Spear!”

I’ll use my Portal skill to see where I can teleport to. It seems it’s recording the location where I saved before the time loop. This is a real find. Before selecting a village near the castle town… I called out to Éclair.
“Éclair, form a party.”
“I told you, my name is Éclair, not Eclair!”
“That’s beside the point.”
“It’s not beside the point… no, fine. A party, then.”
After confirming that Éclair had agreed to the party formation, I used the Portal to teleport to a nearby village.
“What!? Ever since I met Lord Kitamura, it’s been one surprise after another.”
“More importantly, we must find the carriage traveling at night!”
We checked the nearby village to see if the carriage had arrived. However, it seemed there was no such information at the place we’d just stopped at…
“Where were they taken!”
Éclair took out her frustration on the wall.
“Let’s head toward the gate.”
“Is there something there?”
“We’re going to follow the tracks of that unfamiliar carriage.”
“I see!”

We checked the road leading to the castle gate. The direction… the wheel tracks were heading southwest—the opposite of northeast, toward Siltvelt. And the horse’s hoofprints… judging by the condition of the soil, were they made within the last few tens of minutes? Factoring in the time lost passing through the castle town…
“Damn… I should’ve brought a vehicle!”
“Éclair, I’ll go ahead, so you follow behind me.”
“!? Got it. Leave it to me, Lord Kitamura!”

I started running down the highway at full speed. These legs I trained with Filolial-sama and the others! And with the speed granted by my level and stats, will I be able to catch up…? It’s a gamble, but I’m going for it!
